title: Selyth Obligation Set
description: The frozen, human-authored input of verification: the formal obligations a change must satisfy. A report names it by digest, a policy is evaluated against it, and a backend adapter lowers it. Its digest is computed over the canonical form defined in docs/specifications/obligation-set-canonicalization.md, so formatting, key order and the order of set-valued arrays never change it, while any change of meaning does. Every array in this document is a set: its order carries no meaning and is normalised away. Only strings, arrays and objects are allowed, so no number needs a canonical form.

selyth_obligation_set_version.description: Version of this schema and of the canonicalization rules. A change to either is a change of this value, so a digest is never compared across rule sets.

set_id.description: Stable identifier of this Obligation Set across its versions.

specification_version.description: Version of the specification these obligations freeze. Reports echo it per obligation; it must match.

title.description: Optional human label. Part of the digest like every other field: nothing in a frozen set is exempt from the freeze.

obligations.description: A set, keyed by obligation_id. Uniqueness of the key cannot be stated in JSON Schema and is enforced by tools/obligation_set.py.

identifier.description: ASCII, so that identifier comparison and ordering never depend on Unicode normalisation.

obligation_id.description: Stable identifier. Survives refactoring; referenced by reports and policies. Never reused for a different claim.

statement.description: The formal claim, in the backend's obligation language. Compared as written (after Unicode NFC): whitespace inside it is significant.

required_evidence_kind.description: What the acceptance policy demands for this obligation, recorded so a reader sees the gap between demanded and supplied evidence without opening the policy.

intent_statement.description: Optional natural-language intent this obligation formalises. Carried, never promoted into the formal chain (ADR-003). Absent means none was authored; null is not allowed, so there is one representation of 'none'.

assumptions.description: Premises the obligation depends on, stated rather than implied. A set; an empty array means genuinely none.

affected_components.description: Components the obligation constrains. A set.
